recent: KTI Landmark 近期与 TAR UMT 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在 Kota Kinabalu 的 Kayana Heights 提供学生住宿。公司也公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，营收同比增长 47.2%，但净利同比下滑 31.6%。此外，董事 Datuk Loke Theen Fatt 在 10 月多次申报减持股份。
notable: 与 TAR UMT 签署谅解备忘录，探讨在 Kayana Heights 提供学生住宿。

earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 82.115 million，同比增长 47.2%，环比增长 1.0%；净利为 MYR 2.165 million，同比下降 31.6%，环比下降 11.4%；净利率为 2.6%，低于上一季度的 3.0%。

recent_en: KTI Landmark recently signed an MoU with TAR UMT to explore student housing at Kayana Heights in Kota Kinabalu. The company also reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 47.2% year-on-year but net profit down 31.6% year-on-year. In addition, Director Datuk Loke Theen Fatt filed multiple notices of share disposals in October.
notable_en: Signed an MoU with TAR UMT to explore student housing at Kayana Heights.
The Residensi Seri Akasia project received two CIDB awards.
risks_en: Group Managing Director/Chief Executive Officer Datuk Loke Theen Fatt filed multiple notices of disposal of directly held shares in October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 82.115 million, up 47.2% year-on-year and 1.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 2.165 million, down 31.6% year-on-year and 11.4% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 2.6%, lower than 3.0% in the previous quarter.
